title: Fix TypeError: Invalid URL (ERR_INVALID_URL) crash on malformed redirect Location headers
summary: 1) In shopify.proxy-get.ts, safely wrap initial new URL(url) and redirect Location parsing in try/catch to resolve gracefully instead of crashing on malformed redirects like https:/// from domain linetogeljp.fun; 2) Safely wrap redirect Location parsing in shopify.client.ts, product-scraper.service.ts, and safe-fetch.ts; 3) Add unit tests for EINVAL_URL handling in shopify.proxy-get.spec.ts.
